name: techtutor
description: TechTutor - Platform pembelajaran adaptif Troubleshooting IT

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run db:setup
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run build && tsc -b frontend/tsconfig.json
